text: Lengkepan paribasa ieu: “Cikaracak ninggang batu, laun-laun jadi …”
gloss: Complete the proverb: 'Dripping water falling on a stone slowly becomes…' — legok (hollowed): perseverance wins in the end. 'Bolong' (pierced) is the half-remembered trap.

text: Numutkeun dongéng, Sangkuriang najong parahu nu teu kaburu anggeus nepi ka nangkub. Parahu éta jadi gunung naon?
gloss: In the legend, Sangkuriang kicked the unfinished boat so that it overturned. Which mountain did it become? — Tangkuban Parahu ('upturned boat'). Burangrang also belongs to the legend (the branches of the felled tree).

text: Asép ngantri meuli karcis. Di hareupeunana aya tilu urang, di tukangeunana aya opat urang. Sabaraha urang nu ngantri, kaasup Asép?
gloss: Asep queues for a ticket: three people in front, four behind. How many in the queue including him? — 8: 3 + 4 + Asep. 7 is the trap of forgetting him.

text: Sato laut mana nu ngambekan ku bayah sarta nyusuan anakna?
gloss: Which sea animal breathes with lungs and suckles its young? — The dolphin, a mammal. Shark and ray are fish, octopus a mollusc.

text: Suporter Persib Bandung nu sok ngabirukeun stadion téh katelahna …
gloss: Persib Bandung's supporters, who turn the stadium blue, are known as… — Bobotoh. Bonek follow Persebaya, Aremania Arema, The Jakmania Persija.

text: Kecap mana nu dibaca ti hareup atawa ti tukang tetep sarua?
gloss: Which word reads the same forwards and backwards? — tutut (paddy-field snail, a West Javan snack): t-u-t-u-t. The others are not palindromes.

text: Bulan caang ari peuting, padahal teu boga cahaya sorangan. Cahaya ti mana nu dipantulkeunana?
gloss: The Moon shines at night but has no light of its own. Whose light does it reflect? — The Sun's.

text: Waditra naon nu biasana boga 88 konci hideung jeung bodas?
gloss: Which instrument usually has 88 black and white keys? — The piano. A piano accordion also has black and white keys, but far fewer.

text: Buana mana nu ampir sakabéhna katutup ku és, sarta teu boga pangeusi pituin?
gloss: Which continent is almost entirely covered in ice and has no native inhabitants? — Antarctica.

text: Ema ngaliwet tabuh 11.40. Liwetna asak 25 menit ti harita. Tabuh sabaraha liwetna asak?
gloss: Mum starts cooking rice at 11:40; it is done 25 minutes later. At what time? — 12:05: 20 minutes to 12:00, then 5 more.

text: Nini keur nganjang ka imah. Pikeun ngajak manéhna dahar, nu merenah téh: “Mangga, Ni, …”
gloss: Grandma is visiting. To invite her to eat, the proper phrase is 'Please, Grandma, …' — tuang, the polite (lemes) word for someone else eating. 'Neda' is polite but only for oneself, 'emam' is baby talk, 'nyatu' is coarse.

text: Comro téh singgetan tina “oncom di jero”, da eusina oncom. Upama ngaran misro dijieun ku cara nu sarua, naon eusina?
gloss: Comro is short for 'oncom inside'. If misro is named the same way, what is inside? — Palm sugar: misro = 'amis di jero', 'sweet inside'.

text: Buruy nu ngojay di balong, lamun geus gedé bakal jadi naon?
gloss: The 'buruy' swimming in the pond, when grown, becomes what? — A frog: buruy is the Sundanese word for tadpole. Dragonfly larvae also live in water, a deliberate trap.

text: Dina kaulinan barudak, budak nu kudu peureum bari ngitung, tuluy néangan babaturanana nu nyarumput, disebut naon?
gloss: In the children's game, the one who closes their eyes and counts, then looks for the hiding friends, is called… — 'ucing' (cat), as in 'ucing sumput', hide-and-seek. 'Beurit' (mouse) is the cat-and-mouse trap.

text: Botol plastik nu pinuh ku cai ditutup pageuh, tuluy diasupkeun kana freezer sapeuting. Naon nu bisa kajadian?
gloss: A plastic bottle full of water, tightly capped, spends a night in the freezer. What can happen? — It bulges or splits: water expands as it freezes. 'Dented inward' is the trap of assuming cold makes things shrink.

text: Kota mana nu wewengkonna aya di dua buana sakaligus, Éropa jeung Asia?
gloss: Which city lies on two continents at once, Europe and Asia? — Istanbul, split by the Bosporus.

text: Dina catur, buah mana nu ngan bisa léngkah serong waé?
gloss: In chess, which piece can only move diagonally? — The bishop ('gajah' in Indonesian/Sundanese chess). The queen moves diagonally too, but not only.

text: Dina pilem “The Lion King”, saha ngaran bapana Simba?
gloss: In 'The Lion King', what is Simba's father called? — Mufasa. Scar is his uncle.

text: Babasan “kawas cai dina daun taleus” dipaké pikeun jalma nu kumaha?
options: Nu getol digawé ti isuk nepi ka peuting
Nu teu puguh pamadegan, gampang robah
gloss: The saying 'like water on a taro leaf' describes what kind of person? — One with no firm stance, who keeps changing: water rolls around on a taro leaf and never settles.

text: Dina sataun Masehi, sabaraha bulan nu lilana 31 poé?
gloss: In a Gregorian year, how many months have 31 days? — 7: January, March, May, July, August, October, December (the knuckle count gives it).

text: Dina aksara Sunda, unggal aksara ngalagena geus mawa sora “a”, contona “ka”. Tanda nu disebut “pamaéh” gunana pikeun …
gloss: In Sundanese script every consonant letter carries an 'a', e.g. 'ka'. The mark called 'pamaéh' is used to… — remove the vowel, leaving just 'k': the name comes from 'paéh', 'dead', it 'kills' the vowel (a virama).

text: Prasasti Batutulis, nu dijieun pikeun mengét Sri Baduga Maharaja (Prabu Siliwangi), ayana di kota …
gloss: The Batutulis inscription, made in memory of Sri Baduga Maharaja (Prabu Siliwangi), is in which city? — Bogor, the site of Pakuan Pajajaran. Ciamis is the trap: it has the Kawali inscriptions.

text: Kasenian ngarak budak sunatan dina tandu wangun singa nu dipanggul ku opat urang asalna ti kabupatén …
gloss: The art of parading circumcision boys on lion-shaped litters carried by four men comes from which regency? — Subang (Sisingaan).

text: Dina carita Lutung Kasarung, saha saenyana lutung nu ngabéla Purbasari?
gloss: In the tale of Lutung Kasarung, who really is the langur who stands by Purbasari? — Guruminda, a heavenly being in disguise. The others are heroes of other Sundanese tales.

text: Waduk Saguling, Cirata, jeung Jatiluhur kabéh ngabendung walungan nu sarua. Walungan naon?
gloss: The Saguling, Cirata and Jatiluhur reservoirs all dam the same river. Which? — The Citarum, in a cascade.

text: Pilem panjang munggaran nu sakabéh gambarna dijieun ku komputer, dirilis taun 1995, nyaéta …
gloss: The first feature film made entirely by computer, released in 1995? — Toy Story (Pixar). Antz (1998) was the second.

text: Lima babaturan papanggih, sarta unggal dua urang sasalaman sakali. Sabaraha kali sasalaman sakabéhna?
gloss: Five friends meet and every two shake hands once. How many handshakes? — 10: 5 × 4 = 20 counts each handshake twice.

text: Upama Panonpoé ngadadak pareum, sabaraha lila deui Bumi masih kénéh katojo ku cahayana?
gloss: If the Sun suddenly went out, how much longer would Earth still be lit by it? — About eight minutes: the light already on its way still arrives (sunlight takes about 8 min 20 s).

text: Johannes Gutenberg ngamimitian nyitak buku ku hurup-hurup logam nu bisa dipindah-pindah di kota Mainz. Kiwari Mainz kaasup nagara …
gloss: Gutenberg began printing with movable metal type in Mainz. Which country is Mainz in today? — Germany.

text: Saha pelukis Spanyol nu ngagagas aliran kubisme bareng jeung Georges Braque?
gloss: Which Spanish painter founded Cubism together with Georges Braque? — Pablo Picasso. Dalí and Miró are Spanish surrealists, Goya much earlier.

text: Dina basa Sunda, budak jadi barudak, geulis jadi gareulis. Kumaha wangun jamak tina “beureum” ku rarangkén nu sarua?
gloss: Budak → barudak, geulis → gareulis. What is the plural of 'beureum' (red) with the same infix? — baleureum: the infix -ar- becomes -al- when the root contains an r. 'Bareureum' is the autopilot trap.

text: Saha nu ngarobah angklung jadi bisa maénkeun tangga nada diatonis (do-re-mi), nepi ka bisa dipaké ngamaénkeun lagu-lagu ti mancanagara?
gloss: Who made the angklung play the diatonic (do-re-mi) scale, so it could play foreign songs? — Daeng Soetigna (1938). Udjo Ngalagena, founder of Saung Angklung Udjo, was his pupil.

text: Tari Jaipongan, nu ngamekarkeun gerak ketuk tilu jeung pencak silat, diciptakeun ku …
gloss: Jaipongan, developed from ketuk tilu and pencak silat movements, was created by… — Gugum Gumbira (1970s). Tjetje Somantri created the Peacock Dance (Tari Merak).

text: Dina sisindiran, dua padalisan mimiti nu ukur jadi pamanis sora, lain inti maksudna, disebut …
gloss: In a sisindiran (pantun-style verse), the first two lines that only set up the sound, not the meaning, are called… — cangkang ('shell'); the meaning lines are the eusi ('content').

text: Dina Prasasti Ciaruteun di Bogor aya ukiran sapasang tapak suku raja Tarumanagara. Raja saha?
gloss: The Ciaruteun inscription in Bogor bears a pair of carved footprints of a Tarumanagara king. Which? — Purnawarman. Mulawarman is the trap: king of Kutai, in Kalimantan.

text: Saksofon dijieun tina logam, tapi digolongkeun kana waditra tiup kai. Naon sababna?
options: Sorana ti lidah ipis (reed) nu ngageter waktu ditiup
Sok dipaénkeun bareng jeung suling dina orkéstra
gloss: The saxophone is metal but classed as a woodwind. Why? — Its sound comes from a vibrating reed, as in the clarinet. It was never made of wood: Adolphe Sax built it in brass.

text: Basa pamrograman Python dingaranan tina …
gloss: The Python programming language is named after… — the comedy group Monty Python; Guido van Rossum was a fan. The snake is the obvious trap.

text: Dina bulu tangkis, skor hiji game 29–29. Sabaraha poin deui nu kudu diala ku salah saurang pamaén pikeun meunang game éta?
gloss: In badminton a game stands at 29–29. How many more points does a player need to win it? — One: a game is capped at 30, so the next point wins. 'Two' and 'until two clear' are the traps of the 'win by two' rule.

text: Awi, nu bisa jangkung nepi ka puluhan méter, sacara botani kaasup kulawarga …
gloss: Bamboo, which can grow tens of metres tall, botanically belongs to which family? — The grasses (Poaceae).

text: Taun Hijriah kira-kira 11 poé leuwih pondok ti taun Masehi, jadi Lebaran unggal taun maju. Sanggeus kira-kira sabaraha taun Lebaran balik deui kana tanggal Masehi nu ampir sarua?
gloss: The Hijri year is about 11 days shorter, so Eid moves earlier each year. After about how many years does it return to nearly the same Gregorian date? — About 33: 365 ÷ 11 ≈ 33. 19 is the trap (the Metonic cycle of the Jewish calendar).

text: “Baruang ka nu Ngarora” (1914), nu dianggap novél basa Sunda munggaran, dikarang ku …
gloss: 'Baruang ka nu Ngarora' (1914), regarded as the first Sundanese novel, was written by… — D.K. Ardiwinata. The others are later Sundanese prose writers.

text: Naskah lontar Bujangga Manik, catetan perjalanan hiji pangeran Pakuan nu milih jadi pandita, kiwari disimpen di perpustakaan kota …
gloss: The palm-leaf manuscript of Bujangga Manik, the travels of a Pakuan prince turned hermit, is kept in a library in which city? — Oxford (Bodleian Library, since the 1620s). Leiden, home of many Indonesian manuscripts, is the trap.

text: Dina kasenian tarawangsa ti Rancakalong, Sumedang, waditra gesek tarawangsa sok dibarengan ku waditra petik leutik nu disebut …
gloss: In the tarawangsa music of Rancakalong, Sumedang, the bowed tarawangsa is accompanied by a small plucked zither called… — jentréng.

text: Hadiah Sastra Rancagé, pangajén taunan pikeun karya sastra basa daérah, diadegkeun taun 1989 ku …
gloss: The Rancagé Literary Award for works in regional languages was founded in 1989 by… — Ajip Rosidi. The others are well-known Sundanese and Indonesian writers.

text: Nagara mana nu boga zona waktu pangloba di dunya lamun wilayah peuntas lautna diitung?
gloss: Which country has the most time zones once its overseas territories are counted? — France (12), thanks to territories from the Pacific to the Indian Ocean. Russia and the US have 11 each.

text: Basa kalénder Grégorian mimiti dipaké, poé sanggeus Kemis 4 Oktober 1582 téh Jumaah tanggal …
gloss: When the Gregorian calendar began, the day after Thursday 4 October 1582 was Friday… — 15 October: ten days were dropped. 14 is the trap of skipping ten numbers instead of ten days.

text: Van Gogh ngalukis “The Starry Night” (1889) tina jandéla kamarna di hiji tempat perawatan. Di kota mana?
gloss: Van Gogh painted 'The Starry Night' (1889) from his room window in an asylum. In which town? — Saint-Rémy-de-Provence. Arles came just before, Auvers-sur-Oise just after.

text: Larutan pH 3 dibandingkeun jeung larutan pH 5. Sabaraha kali leuwih loba ion hidrogén dina larutan pH 3?
gloss: A pH 3 solution vs a pH 5 solution: how many times more hydrogen ions in the pH 3 one? — 100: pH is logarithmic, each unit is a factor of 10.

text: Kaulinan Minecraft mimitina dijieun ku programer ti nagara …
gloss: Minecraft was first made by a programmer from which country? — Sweden (Markus 'Notch' Persson, Mojang). Finland, home of Angry Birds, is the trap.

text: Saffron, bungbu nu pangmahalna di dunya, dicokot tina bagian kembang nu mana?
gloss: Saffron, the world's most expensive spice, comes from which part of the flower? — The stigma (crocus stigmas, hand-picked). Stamens are the trap.
